summary: The agent implements a solid regression pipeline with extensive feature engineering and target encoding. However, it fails to account for the temporal structure of the ACA FUL dataset by employing a random train/test split, leading to temporal data leakage. It also reuses the early stopping validation set to fit ensemble weights, causing sequential overfitting, and ignores the highly skewed nature of the target variable.
